Yes. The current evidence (version 2, as of 2026-11-12) shows that all four sensors (VIIRS S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21 and MODIS) covered every day from 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-08. Within that coverage, FIRMS found no thermal detections intersecting the property.

An earlier version (version 1, as of 2026-10-08) had gaps for 2026-10-07 to 2026-10-08, because the near-real-time data hadn't yet been updated. Version 2 supersedes it and closes those gaps.

Limits: this doesn't prove no fire occurred, since small, short, cool or cloud-obscured fires can go undetected. It also says nothing about burned area, the cause of any change, or dates outside this period.
